svg.title: NO SUS Canary
svg.desc: The pixel canary and the NO SUS wordmark. Every reader gets their own copy. Every open is a receipt on Solana devnet. Three copy badges: copy 1 made for Priya, copy 2 made for Ben, copy 3 not opened, each with slightly different wording of the same line.
svg.text: Every reader gets their own copy.
Every open is a receipt on Solana devnet.
